How are deeply complex wikis organized, structured and maintained, given their non-hierarchical system?

For example, the URL almost always shows some variation of the following schema:

`"File_name_with_separated_spaces"` `"File:Special_(Wiki)"`

There has got to be a more effective solution for this kind of structure! Or does it reveal something more important?...perhaps due to their multi-collaborator nature... this is most likely the "summed structure" between different possible sytsems of struturing.

The fact that massive wiki's of this nature are structuring real-world (and sometimes, very niche information...) almost serves as the backbone of the surface web... this is in essence, the original intent of the Hyperlinked Internet... and it closely resembles Connectomes in the Brain... among other systems... which is a discussion for another channel.
